review.brief_reason: The proposal factors terms 1-4 by x0*x1 and terms 5-7 by -x2, leaves terms 8-11 verbatim, and uses identical constants and variable names (x0,x1,x2,x3). The only structural change is in term 6: sqrt(Abs(sin(pi*sin(pi*Min(0.4275...,sqrt(Abs(x2))))))) becomes sqrt(sin(...)) with Abs removed. This is exact, not merely cosmetic: Min(0.42753242915424394, sqrt(Abs(x2))) lies in [0,0.4275...], so the first sin argument lies in [0, pi*0.4275] subset of [0,pi], giving sin in [0,1]; multiplying by pi keeps the second sin argument in [0,pi], so the outer sin is >=0 for every real x2. Hence Abs is redundant and the sqrt argument stays nonnegative, so domain and operator semantics are preserved and no real counterexample exists.
